"Carrie" is a power ballad by the Swedish rock band Europe released in 1987.
It was the third single released internationally from the album The Final Countdown and was a Top 30 hit in several territories worldwide.

In the US, it is their highest-charting song on the Billboard Hot 100 chart—peaking at #3 (#1 on the Radio and Records chart) during the fall of 1987, outperforming the band's most internationally successful song, "The Final Countdown".
